message_text: quick question - is there a payment plan available? I can't afford to pay the full semester upfront.
Yes! We offer a monthly payment plan that splits your semester balance into 4 equal payments with no interest.
Where do I sign up for it? I can't find it anywhere on the website.
You can enroll through the Student Portal under Bursar > Payment Plans. There is a $35 enrollment fee per semester.
Another fee... of course. Is there a fee for the fee too?
I understand your frustration with the additional costs. The enrollment fee is a one-time charge per semester.
